name: Holds Standards Subscription
description: A Security Hub hub holds a standard enabled on it (hub -> standards subscription): one item securityhub:GetEnabledStandards returned, called unfiltered and read to its last page. Containment: the hub declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, and its one surface per hub is complete when that listing read to its end. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
